chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from Ṣafwān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from his father Bukayr ibn Aʿyan, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام about the nāṣib who leads us in prayer: what do you say regarding prayer with him?
He said: As for when he recites aloud, then remain silent for the Qur'an and listen; then bow and prostrate yourself for yourself.

key_terms.النَّاصِبِ: one hostile to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.لِلْقُرْآنِ: for the recitation of the Qur'an
key_terms.يَؤُمُّنَا: leads us in salat (prayer) as Imam

ai.seo_question: What should one do when praying behind someone who is not to be followed in prayer and he recites aloud?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of praying behind one who is not to be followed in prayer. It instructs that when such a person recites aloud, one should remain silent and listen to the Qur'an, then perform the bowing and prostration for oneself.
